title: Toast pinned to a corner
summary: position: absolute with inset pins a notification to the bottom-right of its stage.
explanation: The toast is absolute, so it leaves the flow and the content underneath does not move when it appears. inset: auto 16px 16px auto sets only the right and bottom offsets, and leaves top and left unset.

The offsets are measured from the nearest positioned ancestor, which is the stage here. position: fixed would pin the toast to the browser window instead, which is the right choice for a real app but would escape this preview box.
tryThis: Change inset to auto auto 16px 16px to pin the toast to the bottom-left.
Remove position: relative from .stage: the toast jumps out to the whole preview.
Set z-index: -1 on .toast and see it slip behind the content.

children.text: Page content keeps its place. The toast appears in the corner without pushing anything.
